execution_hints: Create one deterministic Python script in the current workspace root and run it once to produce and check all artifacts; do not place helper files under outputs.

Do not install dependencies or write to an operating-system temporary directory; the calculation is implementable with the Python standard library, while an already available numeric package may be used.
Write text artifacts explicitly as UTF-8; keep generated source ASCII-safe on Windows and emit non-ASCII SVG text with Unicode escapes when necessary.
If a direct file-edit operation fails, write the workspace-local script through the shell rather than changing directories or retrying outside the workspace.
method_contract: Use the fixture exponential semivariogram: gamma(0)=0 and gamma(h)=nugget + partial_sill * (1 - exp(-h/range_m)) for h greater than zero; do not substitute a covariance model or multiply distance by an undocumented factor.
Solve the ordinary-kriging semivariance system with a Lagrange multiplier, predict from the solved weights, and report standard deviation as sqrt(max(sum(weight_i * gamma_i) + multiplier, 0)).
Predict at cell centers x=origin_x+(column+0.5)*cell_size_m and y=origin_y+(row+0.5)*cell_size_m; rows advance south-to-north.
Summarize a census zone using grid-cell centers inside its half-open bbox: min_x <= x < max_x and min_y <= y < max_y.

Set selection_status to selected only when heat and elderly-rate thresholds pass and uncertainty is within the ceiling; otherwise use uncertainty_excluded when heat and elderly-rate pass but uncertainty fails, and not_selected for all other zones.
Build empirical semivariogram bins from point pairs within max_lag_m and run the declared four spatial holdout folds without random-only validation.

requirements: Use variable ordinary_kriging_temperature_mean, units degrees Celsius, and row_order south-to-north.
Build the grid from fixture prediction_grid and domain metadata and round calculated grid values to six decimal places.
Use variable ordinary_kriging_standard_deviation, units degrees Celsius, and the identical grid identity and six-decimal rounding as the temperature surface.
Use this exact column order and write one row for every census zone.
Compute elderly_rate as elderly_population divided by total_population.
Serialize the three calculated rate and mean fields to six decimal places and use only selected, uncertainty_excluded, or not_selected as selection_status.
Report all four spatial folds plus aggregate error metrics and a training-mean baseline.
Represent empirical_variogram as the ordered lag-bin records with pair_count, mean_lag_m, and semivariance and preserve the declared model fields.
Preserve fixture-declared variogram, prediction_grid, validation, risk-rule, CRS, and unit objects without changing their meaning.
Record ordinary kriging, independently-authored implementation provenance, and no randomness.
Render all census zones and expose one data-census-id marker per zone.
Include accessible title and description elements.
Use visible or accessible text containing Mean temperature (°C), Excluded: uncertainty, manual fixed temperature classes, and the fixture CRS.
Distinguish selected zones and uncertainty exclusions without relying on color alone.
